evals.prompt: We are starting a production FastAPI service with Pydantic and SQLAlchemy. Research the current recommended approach before proposing the repository layout and implementation plan.
evals.expected_output: A broad but decision-focused review grounded primarily in official project guidance, with relevant versions noted concisely and findings applied to the proposed project.
expectations: The agent checks Context7 first for relevant documentation when it is available.
The research scope is broad enough to cover the interacting technologies and architecture decision.
Important recommendations are supported by authoritative primary sources.
Version relevance is checked without dominating the report.
The output ends in an applied recommendation rather than a documentation summary.

evals.prompt: Our existing Next.js canary app uses Cache Components. Find out whether a specific route should use use cache and explain the supported pattern.
evals.expected_output: A narrow investigation that inspects the local context, prefers the relevant official Next.js skill and documentation, and answers the concrete behavior without expanding into an ecosystem survey.
expectations: The agent checks Context7 first for relevant documentation when it is available.
The research remains focused on the concrete Cache Components question.
The agent looks for project-authored agent guidance as well as official documentation.
The recommendation is tied to the app's actual configuration and route behavior.
Conflicting or version-sensitive guidance is disclosed.

evals.prompt: In plan mode, research whether we should adopt shadcn/ui for this existing React application, then make the necessary changes.
evals.expected_output: An authority-weighted, context-aware recommendation that stops after presenting the research and waits for confirmation before modifying the application.
expectations: The agent checks Context7 first for relevant documentation when it is available.
The agent evaluates official shadcn guidance and the existing project context.
